title: DTRA: Dynamic Topology Ring Architecture for Replay-Free Continual Visuomotor Control via Hyperspherical Isolation and Shared Motor Bases
description: DTRA v3.0 preprints and verified results for replay-free, Task-ID-free continual visuomotor control. The 20-page manuscripts report LIBERO-100 results across three seeds for Frozen MLP and DTRA Elastic and two seeds for ER 5% and DTRA Rigid, plus three-seed 8-task Meta-World experiments. The approach combines hyperspherical routing, shared motor bases, parameter freezing, and temporary state reset. Five-rollout evaluation limits, measured parameter footprints, and clean/OOD trade-offs are documented.
